base_prompt:
Randomly choose ONE thumbnail style from this list to maintain uniqueness (do not repeat styles used in the last two thumbnails):

• Big Face — smiling creator pointing at the guest invite screen.
• Split-Screen — left side “Private Workspace,” right side “Guest Invited.”
• Red Arrow — ClickUp interface with a bold red arrow pointing to the “Invite Guest” option.
• Minimalist Text — clean background with ClickUp logo and huge bold text like “INVITE GUEST!”
• Action Shot — cursor clicking “Invite” with motion blur and a new user appearing.
• Chart/Data — faceless design showing team members and guests collaborating in tasks.
• VS Battle — “No Guest vs Guest Access.”
• POV — first-person perspective inviting a guest inside ClickUp.
• Collage — 3–4 small UI screenshots showing: workspace → invite → email input → guest added.
• High-Saturation Graphic — bright vector icons like users, plus signs, arrows, collaboration symbols, and ClickUp branding.

High-CTR Design Principles:

• Instant Clarity: viewers understand the topic in 0.2 seconds.
• Positive Expression: if a face is used, a confident or smiling reaction filling ~40% of the frame.
• Visual Contrast: bright vibrant colors with deep shadows so elements pop.
• Minimal Text: 3–5 bold words max, huge and readable on mobile.
• Authority Bias: show ClickUp interface, collaboration panel, or logo.
• Storytelling: illustrate the transformation private workspace → guest invited to collaborate.
• Curiosity: make viewers want to learn how to invite guests quickly.
